aligner_calibration_finding: In wav2vec2-lv-60-espeak-cv-ft on real Nepali audio, Nepali inherent vowel अ (/ʌ/) is emitted primarily as 'ɐ', 'ə', 'ɔ', 'o', and 'ɑ' (almost never literal 'ʌ'). Therefore, naive argmax matching on 'ʌ' fails (0.0 hits), whereas mapping Nepali /ʌ/ to logsumexp(logits[:, [id('ʌ'), id('ə'), id('ɐ'), id('ɔ'), id('o')]]) recovers 100% of Nepali inherent-vowel emission peaks for CTC Viterbi forced alignment!
